name: Allmhuin
text: Allmhuinn is a further spelling of the old form of the Hill of Allen. MacKaelen records the spelling in the set of forms for the hill in County Kildare. The same figures follows the story of the home of the hero Fine.

attributes.attribute: spelling of the Hill of Allen

okr.objective: Give a spelling of the name of the Hill.
key_results: Name the spelling as a form of the Hill of Allen.
Point the reader to the hill in County Kildare.
